covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SXE-52, authored by muse-b3 as author of record (CB-0828; registrar-only conversion of the check file's content) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SXE-52.md (fixer muse-b2) and the shipped per-engine docs docs/conkay/engines/{mpi,fenicsx,petsc,calculix,openfoam}.md, build 68f2886e5 on branch sx/heavy-engines (parent d0aa89016, SXE-51's landing). The build carries five engine tickets: SXE-39 (MPI lane, OpenMPI 5.0.11, BSD-3-Clause, cap 8 ranks), SXE-09 (FEniCSx/DOLFINx 0.11.0, LGPL-3.0-or-later, process-only), SXE-03 (PETSc/SLEPc 3.24.0, BSD-2-Clause, installed into the fenicsx env per plan §2), SXE-11 (OpenFOAM v2406, GPL-3.0-only, process-only), SXE-07 (CalculiX 2.23, GPL-2.0-only, process-only) — each an entry at server/lib/conkay/engines/entries/<id>.js plus a kernel at server/lib/conkay/engines/kernels/kernel-<id>.py speaking the SXE-00 protocol, with two-level presence semantics (driver env absent → engine_unavailable:<id>; env present but binary/library missing → engine_failed:<id>:<what is missing>). Scope is the CI-only scope of the founder F1 ruling (2026-11-18): kernels + CI lanes built; prod answers NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable until a compute host exists. Provenance: INDEPENDENT — every health reference is a closed form or a published table re-pulled independently of the engines: single-element tension σ = P/A, δ = PL/(EA); Euler–Bernoulli PL³/(3EI); the manufactured Poisson solution u = 1 + x² + 2y²; the exact discrete eigenvalue (4/h²)·sin²(πh/2); Ghia, Ghia & Shin 1982 Table 1 (transcription re-pulled from a 2026 validation paper). Two riders carried exactly as filed in the check file: (i) CalculiX health substitution — the plan words a 'one-element cantilever vs closed form', but a one-element cantilever has no exact closed form; the health leg is a single C3D8 element in uniaxial tension vs the exact closed form (rel < 1e-3), with a kernel-generated C3D20 cantilever (band 8% vs Euler–Bernoulli) as companion; accepted at the office in this honest form. (ii) F3 FLAG — the OpenFOAM version pin is the ESI (openfoam.com) v2406 line, the plan's F3 SAFE DEFAULT, not an express founder ruling; the kernel is distribution-agnostic, so a flip is a one-line pin + provisioning change; named for the founder's cluster. NOT CLAIMED: the H2 host legs of all five engine tickets (provisioning, present=true on a host) — deferred-open under F1, not built; SXE-06 (gmsh) registration — a kernel-level meshing dependency riding its own unseated ticket; any solver tier that consumes these engines — those rows carry their own follow-ons; the five CI workflow files are git-route deliverables with this build (manual dispatch per F8). Tier 1 is PROPOSED in the check file — assigned at acceptance by the reviewer. steps: engineListReport carries five new rows (mpi, fenicsx, petsc, calculix, openfoam), each engineDependent: true, each with the pinned version + licence of record; validateManifestEntry is clean for all five; GPL/LGPL entries are linkMode 'process'.

PETSc CI lane: KSP Poisson health max error < 1e-3; SLEPc smallest eigenvalue vs the exact discrete value (4/h²)·sin²(πh/2), rel err < 1e-6; non-convergence returns converged:false → engine_not_converged.
